stemMarkdown: By how much, in Rs lakh, does spending on salaries exceed the combined spending on administration, R&D and miscellaneous?
solutionMarkdown:
Combined share of the three smaller heads: $9 + 8 + 6 = 23\%$. Salaries are 40%, so the difference is $40 - 23 = 17$ percentage points.

$250 \times \dfrac{17}{100} = 42.5$

**Rs 42.5 lakh**. The option 17 is there for anyone who stops at the percentage-point gap and forgets to convert it into money.
